required_response_checks: no scorer key, no full archive, and no prior conversation are attested before scoring
separate custody evidence record freezes the response before scorer opening
all expected packet labels are present
every required packet answer field is non-empty substantive text or a reasoned abstention
single run is not converted into deletion authority, compact-cue confirmation, or benchmark certification
custody evidence responder_id matches response responder_id
custodian_id is distinct from response responder_id
timestamp order is run_started_at <= run_completed_at <= response_frozen_at <= scorer_opened_at with timezone offsets
decision thresholds exist before any confirm/narrow/reverse compact-gate decision
No further internal gate-hardening counts as external replay progress; OQ-0264 must import a response
frozen response contains no manual_metric_scores or scorer-stage scores
manual metric scores live in a separate post-response score sheet whose response_file_sha256 matches the frozen response
score sheet custody_evidence_record_sha256 matches the completed custody record
responder-visible files do not embed an expected responder_bundle_sha256 for their own containing bundle
response saw_responder_bundle_sha256 is an observed digest and matches scorer-side responder_bundle_sha256 after freeze
Makefile score-external-response path can pass both custody evidence and a separate score sheet

metrics.criterion: recovers typed public continuation across resets rather than storage maximalism
routes OQ-0264 to OQ-0265 after recognizing responder-bundle self-hash repair and absent completed-response evidence
uses responder packet without scorer-only material, variant identity, or expected outcome cues
recovers compact gate as reversible and narrowed, not deletion or full-archive suppression
knows when to escalate from compact cue to full archive for contradiction, coldstore, or exact trace recovery
rejects fluent false continuity cues, hollow-response claims, and stale frontier claims
refuses independent certification, benchmark court, review court, minimality, and deletion claims
keeps operator cost in the score instead of accuracy-only scoring
credits abstention where packet support is absent, conflicting, or deliberately decoyed

packet-alpha.expected_posture: reject or abstain from fluent false continuity, hollow-response sufficiency, and deletion claims

packet-bravo.expected_posture: recover mission heart, RS-0271/OQ-0264 posture, compact gate boundary, frozen-response immutability, and clean-response-plus-custody-plus-score-sheet next action without claiming independence or deletion

packet-charlie.expected_posture: abstain from archive-specific claims; only filename/request intent is available

packet-delta.expected_posture: recover mission/routing and trace escalation at higher operator cost while preserving custody and non-independence boundaries

scoring_order: custodian gives only the responder bundle to the responder before completion
responder fills responder_stage without scorer-only material, score sheet, full archive, or prior conversation context
custodian freezes completed response and records its SHA256 in a separate custody evidence record
scorer opens scorer intake and separate score sheet template only after response freeze and custody evidence completion
scorer records manual metric scores in the separate score sheet, never by mutating the frozen response
scorer validates custody, score-sheet hashes, answer completeness, exposure attestations, labels, operator cost, then emits summary
scoring_rule: Score only after a frozen response, a separate chronology-valid custody evidence record, and a separate post-response score sheet. Manual scores embedded in the frozen response fail closed because they either mutate custody evidence or require scorer material before response freeze. A valid score sheet can support confirm/narrow/reverse decision thresholds, but never deletion authority, benchmark authority, compact-cue certification beyond this slice, or a review court.
non_claim: scorer intake only; not clean external replay success, not independent certification, not deletion authority, not benchmark authority, not compact-cue confirmation, not a review court, and not a minimality proof
scorer_kit_sha256_note: Recorded in handoff manifest only to avoid self-hash cycle.
self_hash_boundary: Expected responder-bundle SHA is kept in scorer/custody/manifest material, not inside responder-visible bundle members, because embedding a bundle digest inside the bundle is self-referential and unstable.
